request.title: Ask the factory for what is missing
request.description: The functional contract of what you lack: the outputs a plan must produce (name, quantity, unit, horizon), the constraints (a residual threshold and its window), what you observed (volumes, door, occupancy, scrubbers), the data available (telemetry files with their columns), the topics and a budget. The factory opens a workspace, writes the task file and returns the task id; it builds nothing at this call, its loop does, and it ends by proposing to the station, which asks the twin's judgment. Ask for the need, never for a solution.

properties.objective: what must be produced and under which constraints: required_outputs and constraints
properties.observations: what you saw: volumes, door, occupancy, scrubbers with their speed and current
properties.data: files of telemetry the factory may use, with their columns
properties.profile: the profile the loop runs with

task.title: Where a task stands
task.description: The state of a factory task (created, running, proposed, accepted, rejected, failed), its workspace, the sha256 of its task file, how many files it holds, and its manifest when the loop has written one.

properties.taskId: the task id returned by request
